CRM notes (compact, call-style):
- Company: SupportSprout Labs — 20 engineers, YC alum, building a lightweight ticket triage layer that plugs into Zendesk and Intercom.
- Primary ask: hosted, self-serve API to run ticket summarization + structured extraction (issue_type, priority, customer_sentiment) and tool-calling to create/update tickets.
- Latency needs: 200-400ms p50 for summary endpoint; can tolerate 1s p95 for long threads. Throughput: spikes to ~80 reqs/min during business hours, avg 12/min. Cost sensitive — trying to keep monthly infra <$2k while proving feature engagement.
- Model preferences: open to small/medium open models; want us to recommend quantized variants. Emphasis on cost/perf tradeoffs.
- Routing/fallback: want auto-fallback to cheaper model if p95 latency exceeds 1s. Also want streaming for UI.
- Security: must support SSO for internal admin UI, audit logs for API usage, and configurable retention for PII fields. No need for VPC/on-prem at MVP — public cloud OK.
- Quote from CTO: "We want something we can bolt on in <1 week and iterate fast — low friction SDKs are key."
- Internal notes: good target for Hosted API self-serve flow + onboarding checklist. Likely to convert to paid within 30–60 days if POC hits latency/cost targets.
- Risks: will evaluate other hosted providers (OpenAI + Cohere) side-by-side; careful on ROI measurement (needs hook to show reduced agent handle time).
- Ask for Redwood: provide sample SDK snippet for tool-calling + example structured-output JSON schema we can drop into UI.
